AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Food Nutrients.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Food Nutrients.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Food Nutrients.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Water Retention Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Food Nutrients and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Trees and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Establishment Planting Site and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. A — Glucose and oxygen

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.

6. C — newton (N)

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.

8. C — 100 °C

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

10. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
